The current treatment was already done — the name raised and glowing on the black obsidian, in white light, elegant and beautiful — so there is nothing to invent. The fix is a harvest: take the Micheal certificate's treatment verbatim and put it where the old one stands. Never rebuild a deed from scratch when the real one already exists.
